description.tr: Moğol tehdidi sırasında Halep'i naip olarak yönetti ve Firdevs Medresesi'ni kurdu || Eyyûbî kraliyet kadınları medrese, hastane ve tekkelerin velut hamileleriydi. || [Tarih notu] Yasser Tabbaa'nın çalışmaları Firdevs'i Halep'in mimari başyapıtlarından biri olarak belgeler.
description.en: Ruled Aleppo as regent during the Mongol threat and founded the Firdaws Madrasa — demonstrating how Ayyubid royal women shaped educational infrastructure || Ayyubid royal women were prolific patrons of madrasas, hospitals, and Sufi lodges. Dhayfa Khatun's Firdaws Madrasa still stands in Aleppo, though damaged in recent conflict. || [Historiographical note] Yasser Tabbaa's work documents the Firdaws as one of Aleppo's architectural masterpieces. Recent conflict has partially damaged the structure.
description.ar: حكمت حلب نيابةً خلال التهديد المغولي وأسست المدرسة الفردوسية || كانت النساء الملكيات الأيوبيات راعيات غزيرات للمدارس والمستشفيات
